items.title: Tom Albert and Milton "Mooney" Martin Interview, 1964-12-21
items.q: Yeah, he come play with us, he played tuba.

ctx.x: And that's when Louis went on the boat.

And then Joe Howell come play with the Riker, with us. Yeah, well that's the, yeah. Yeah, he come play with us, he played tuba. He played tuba then. Yeah, played bass. And then, so he stood with us until Wilson, he died, you know. He died twice didn't he, Joe Howell. Yeah.
